execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT 
  cs.canonical_smiles, 
  cr.compound_name, 
  m.met_conversion, 
  m.pathway_key
FROM metabolism m
JOIN compound_records cr ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno
LIMIT 200
```
